requirement.description: {model_monica} proposed a fully automated model registry where every deployment is traceable and reproducible. She wants the registry to run on its own for quick version checks.
requirement.fact: {model_monica} proposed a fully automated model registry where every deployment is traceable and reproducible.
requirement.reading: She wants the registry to run on its own for quick version checks.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: A registry that only logs versions is not enough for the trust we need from store managers. I want the system to actively flag when a new model performs worse on the latest promotion week data before it goes live.
output.correction: I am not talking about manual sign off for every single change, which would kill our weekly retraining cycle. I mean the registry should enforce automated performance gates so a bad model never reaches the morning order window.
